comparison.objective: Commission a shock absorber versus exchange and correctly orient a lithography mask on a vacuum holder.
comparison.physical_skill: Keyed fastener manipulation and response-based adjustment versus vacuum sequencing, delicate bimanual flipping, stop alignment, and placement.
comparison.success_condition: Two safe repeatable carriage stops with retained setting versus Layer 2 mask chrome-side down against stops with vacuum left on. No geometric tolerance is stated.
comparison.reason: The record tests fragile orientation-sensitive exchange; the candidate tests dynamic parameter commissioning and mechanical lock retention.
